name: Boswellia
short: In meta-analyses of knee osteoarthritis trials, adverse events did not differ from placebo. A review lists it among herbs with case reports of severe adverse effects when taken with warfarin.
text: In a meta-analysis of 11 randomised trials in knee osteoarthritis (1009 participants), safety outcomes did not differ significantly between boswellia or curcuminoid formulations and placebo, although study quality was low overall. A later network meta-analysis of 20 trials likewise found no significant differences in adverse events. A review of warfarin interactions with medicinal herbs included Boswellia serrata among herbs for which case reports describe severe adverse effects, such as bleeding, after use together with warfarin.
